India U-19 batsmen score fifties against Sri Lanka

Anvay Dravid, son of Rahul Dravid, scored 87 runs and Arjun Rajput scored 76 runs for the India U-19 team against Sri Lanka. Their partnership helped the team recover from an early collapse and post a total of 285 runs. Sri Lanka was set a target of 286 runs in the second Youth ODI.
